title: Flux-Based Time Bounds for Harmonically Degenerate Quantum Systems
summary: We study transfer-time estimates for finite-dimensional bilinear quantum control systems driven by an unbounded scalar control, in both the state-to-state setting (complex projective space) and the unitary synthesis setting (special unitary group). Lower bounds are recalled and refined via spectral and chordal methods. The main contribution is constructive upper bounds: we associate with the system a coupling graph whose edges correspond to non-resonant drift couplings, and construct transfer protocols along spanning trees.
